mechanisms.critical: context.fail(code,msg) -> StepFailure -> results.json critical_errors[] (critical:true); executor marks remaining tasks SKIPPED, finish_run('failed')

meta.note: water IS a first-class worker type -> solvent gets its own icon slot; 'other' UI fallback maps 'unknown'

resolver_human_names.blast_nr_protein: BLAST search of the NR protein database
resolver_human_names.pdb_struct_protein: protein structure similarity search in PDB
resolver_human_names.pdb_struct_nucleotide: nucleotide structure similarity search in PDB

interpolation_rules.identifier_resolver_failed: message format '{resolver} ({generator}): {error}'; resolver_human = resolver_human_names[resolver] else resolver; reason_human = match error against raw_error_map keys (substring, case-insens) else 'did not finish'; NEVER show raw error (may contain internal paths); technical detail expandable shows sanitized message (strip /app/... paths)
interpolation_rules.signature_generator_failed: message format '{generator}: {error}'; generator_human = signature human-name map (CONTEXT.md)

codes.user_what: The structure has very few chemical bonds, which usually happens with PDB files that lack CONECT records. Molecule detection may be unreliable.
codes.user_action: Re-run with 'Guess missing bonds' enabled (Advanced configuration → Loader).

codes.user_title: Structure appears split across periodic boundaries
codes.user_what: Molecules look broken across the edges of the simulation box.
codes.user_action: Re-run with 'Unwrap periodic boundaries' enabled (Advanced configuration → Loader).

codes.user_what: Periodic boundary unwrapping was applied to make molecules whole.
Unwrapping was enabled but did not succeed; some molecules may still appear split.
codes.user_action: Re-run; contact us if it repeats.

codes.user_what: The {generator_human} signature does not apply to this molecule, so it was skipped. This is expected by design - other signatures were still generated and used.
The {resolver_human} did not complete ({reason_human}), so some matches may be missing.
codes.user_action: Usually nothing is wrong with your data. You can re-run the annotation for a complete search.

raw_error_map.timed out: took too long and was stopped
raw_error_map.BLAST timed out: took too long and was stopped

codes.user_what: Segment {segment} could not be verified; its matches may be less reliable.

codes.user_title: A step ran over its time budget
codes.user_what: The step continued with partial results; some searches may be incomplete.
codes.user_action: Re-running may produce more complete results.

codes.user_what: Some downloadable output files may be missing.
codes.user_action: Re-run if you need the exports.

codes.user_what: Some downloadable files for segment {segment} may be missing.

codes.user_title: Input files could not be understood
codes.user_what: The uploaded files did not form a loadable simulation input.
codes.user_action: Include a topology (.tpr or .top with all .itp includes) and ideally a .gro file — or upload everything as a .zip.

codes.user_title: Simulation files could not be loaded
codes.user_what: Several loading strategies were tried and none succeeded.
codes.user_action: Check the Input & Files tab for what was uploaded and try a different/complete file set.

codes.user_what: The loaded structure was not available to a later step.
codes.user_action: Please re-run; contact us if it repeats.

codes.user_what: A processing component was unavailable mid-run.
codes.user_action: Please re-run; contact us if it repeats.

codes.user_what: Something went wrong that we did not anticipate.
codes.user_action: Please re-run; contact us with the run ID if it repeats.

codes.user_what: The processing job failed before completion.
codes.user_action: Please re-run; contact us with the run ID if it repeats.
